_comment: Gzipped byte budgets per entry point. Enforced by scripts/check-size.mjs in CI. Raise deliberately with `node scripts/check-size.mjs --update` and justify it in the commit — the root entry runs in every consumer's edge middleware on every request.

dist/index.js.note: Root: detection, classification, agentPolicy, trackVisit. The one that matters — keep it tight.

dist/verify.js.note: Carries the published IP range tables, which grow when the weekly refresh adds prefixes. Extra headroom for that.

dist/firewall.js.note: Offline analysis tool; never runs in middleware, so size buys correctness cheaply here. Raised from 3200 for the distributed-pool rule class and the link-unfurler bypass.
